DM shall lock SOVD entity after time expiration DM shall terminate all resources associated with the lock as well as temporary resources when expiration time for the acquired lock times out. DM shall return HTTP 195 of 1171 Document ID 723: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_Diagnostics Specification of Diagnostics AUTOSAR AP R25-11 status code 409 as response when SOVD client…

DM shall allow access only to unlocked SOVD entities DM shall not allow a SOVD client to access a SOVD entity which requires a lock, but the client has not acquired the lock before, and will send HTTP status code 409 as a response.

DM shall allow only one lock per SOVD entity DM shall not allow a SOVD client to acquire a lock on the SOVD entity (or SOVD sub entity) if another SOVD client has locked the same SOVD entity for accessing or operating on the SOVD entity resource and return error code.
Parallel SOVD client handling The DM shall treat a SOVD client without a lock like a UDS (ISO 14229-1) client regarding parallel client handling.
SOVD lock in UDS extended session Acquiring a SOVD lock shall only be possible if no UDS (ISO 14229-1) client is in extended session.
